answer: I did not run the job. The IQM API reports that garnet has 20 qubits (QB1 to QB20), and garnet:mock reports the same. A 30-qubit GHZ circuit needs 30 qubits, so it cannot run on garnet. Submitting it would only fail or spend credits for nothing, so I submitted no jobs. You can run a GHZ circuit of 20 qubits or fewer on garnet, or use a backend with at least 30 qubits.
